summary: Phase D SizeSlider regression. Frontend: all 6 acceptance criteria PASS — slider renders below chips on shirts, ticks for S/M/L exist (no XL on Pullover by design), star marker visible above the recommended size (S), tapping L updates BOTH the static chip and slider thumb, narrative banner toggles RECOMMENDED ↔ FIT PREVIEW with live fit phrase + score badge, slider correctly hidden on Pointed Leather Mule (shoes). Backend smoke: per_size IS returned with all 4 dimension keys (chest_cm, shoulder_cm, sleeve_cm, length_cm) BUT only chest_cm has body+diff populated; shoulder_cm/sleeve_cm/length_cm have body=null, diff=null because the buyer demo profile (and BodyMeasurements model) lacks those measurements — the seed backfill only filled the garment side. UI gracefully shows only the chest narrative as a result.

minor.issue: per_size dimensions for shoulder_cm, sleeve_cm, length_cm return diff=null because (a) buyer@aurafit.demo profile has shoulders_cm=null, and (b) BodyMeasurements has no sleeve/length-equivalent field. Request specified diff should be populated 'now that we backfilled seed data' — only the garment side was backfilled, not the body side. Net result: narrative banner always says 'across the chest' regardless of which size is picked.

action_items: Backfill /app/backend/seed.py buyer demo profile measurements to include shoulders_cm (e.g. 40) so the shoulder_cm dimension produces a real diff and narrative.

Either extend BodyMeasurements with sleeve_cm + torso/length_cm fields (and seed them), OR document that sleeve_cm + length_cm intentionally report garment-only data with diff=null. Currently the SizeSlider's dominantNarrative correctly handles null diff but only ever surfaces the chest dimension.
critical_code_review_comments: SizeSlider star marker uses Feather 'star' icon. Inspecting via DOM querySelector('svg') returned 0 because @expo/vector-icons renders icons as font glyphs on web — the star IS visible in screenshots (above the S tick) so behaviour is correct, but testing agents using svg selectors will be misled. Consider adding testID='size-slider-star-{label}' to the recommended star marker for unambiguous future testing.
Item Detail screen line 458: gate `fitScore?.per_size && fitScore.per_size.length > 0` correctly hides the slider for shoes (per_size is null/empty for footwear). Verified.
